description: Inep publishes Brazil school-census microdata by release year through the Censo Escolar page, including a 2025 release updated in July 2026. These national administrative statistics describe basic education and provide school-system context. Public microdata must be distinguished from protected individual records; fields and disclosure rules depend on the selected year. No archive was opened in this metadata review. Published by INEP. Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. The provider page is the access route; underlying file formats were not confirmed.
